briefs.name: Personal Finance Reset Breakdown
briefs.whyItWorks: Builds instant trust through vulnerable storytelling about a dramatic financial turnaround, then shows concrete tools and steps (budgeting setup, high-yield accounts) with visual receipts.

beats.shows: Close-up cut to screen recording or notebook showing incoming paycheck and expense breakdown

beats.shows: Back to creator pointing up to savings interest rate graphic and phone app interface
beats.says: Second, move your emergency fund into a high-yield savings account so your cash actually grows.
